verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text convert endpoint documents a natural-language instruction (max 2000 characters) applied to the final transcript, returning the result in 'edited_transcript' alongside the original. A developer could plausibly instruct it to translate, but the evidence never names translation as a supported use, so this credit is tentative. missing for 10: an explicit documented translation option or endpoint, a list of supported target languages, confirmation that instruction-based translation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
